mcp.shell.command.en: Shell command to execute on the target device.
mcp.shell.command.zh-CN: 要在目标设备上执行的 Shell 命令。

mcp.read.new.output.while.the.session.is.en: Read session output from a byte cursor. Pass command_id to reject reads after a newer command starts. Use status to check completion and drain has_more even after idle or closed.
mcp.read.new.output.while.the.session.is.zh-CN: 按字节游标读取会话输出。传入 command_id 可拒绝新命令启动后的读取。用 status 判断是否完成，即使状态为 idle 或 closed，也要读到 has_more=false。

mcp.session.identifier.en: Client-local session identifier. Multi-device calls also require client_id.
mcp.session.identifier.zh-CN: 客户端内唯一的会话标识；多设备调用还必须提供 client_id。

mcp.byte.cursor.initially.0.en: Output byte offset, initially 0; subsequent reads accept the previous next_cursor.
mcp.byte.cursor.initially.0.zh-CN: 输出字节偏移，初始为 0；后续读取可传入上次返回的 next_cursor。

mcp.wait.up.to.this.many.milliseconds.fo.en: Wait up to this many milliseconds for output
mcp.wait.up.to.this.many.milliseconds.fo.zh-CN: 等待输出的最长时间，单位毫秒

mcp.input.bytes.as.text.e.g.yes.n.en: Required only for action=input; omit for other actions. Text is sent as provided without an added newline; include a newline to submit a shell command or prompt response.
mcp.input.bytes.as.text.e.g.yes.n.zh-CN: 仅 action=input 时必填，其他 action 不得填写。文本按原样发送，不自动添加换行符；提交 shell 命令或提示回答时请包含换行符。

mcp.create.a.client.connection.token.and.en: Create an Agenterm remote connection token and invitation. For each optional parameter, use its default unless the user explicitly requests a different value. Do not infer non-default settings from the task or choose them independently. If the user specifies no settings, call with an empty object. Present the entire display_text, translating only its natural-language prose into the user's language. Do not paraphrase, summarize, add, omit, or reorder any content. Preserve all sections and code blocks. Copy commands, URLs, device tokens, and short codes verbatim. Show each original URL as visible text; do not replace it with a Markdown link label. Show the expiry deadline (expires_at) in the user's time zone if known, or UTC otherwise, and label the zone. Keep control_token private and reuse it across turns, including after a wait times out. After presenting the invitation, wait for the device with list_client.
mcp.create.a.client.connection.token.and.zh-CN: 创建 Agenterm 远程连接令牌和邀请。每个可选参数都使用默认值，除非用户明确要求其他值。不要根据任务自行推断或选择非默认设置。用户未指定任何设置时，使用空对象调用。完整展示 display_text，只将其中的自然语言翻译成用户使用的语言。不得改写、摘要、增删或重排内容。保留所有段落和代码块，逐字复制命令、URL、设备令牌和短码。每个原始 URL 都必须作为可见文本显示，不得替换为 Markdown 链接标题。已知用户时区时，按该时区显示过期时间（expires_at），否则用 UTC，并标注时区。私密保管 control_token 并跨轮复用，等待超时后也要保留。展示邀请后调用 list_client 等待设备。

mcp.invitation.timeout.seconds.en: Invitation lifetime in seconds, as a positive integer. Default 900 (15 minutes). Expiry prevents invitation redemption; it does not disconnect devices that have already connected.
mcp.invitation.timeout.seconds.zh-CN: 邀请有效期，单位秒，必须为正整数。默认 900（15 分钟）。过期后不能兑换邀请，已连接的设备不会因此断开。

mcp.target.client.connection.token.requi.en: Control credential in token:key format, required with management access (including stdio and no-password mode). Scoped control bearer access implicitly selects its own token.
mcp.target.client.connection.token.requi.zh-CN: 控制凭证，格式为 token:密钥；管理访问（包括 stdio 和免密模式）时必须填写。控制范围的 Bearer 访问会自动选择其自身 token。

installer.client.authorization.version.en: Agenterm CLI 0.20.16 or newer is required for local authorization.
installer.client.authorization.version.zh-CN: 本地授权需要 Agenterm CLI 0.20.16 或更新版本。

client.already.connected.to.server.en: This account already has a connection to this server on this computer. Disconnect the existing client before reconnecting.
client.already.connected.to.server.zh-CN: 当前账户在本机已有到此服务器的连接，请先断开已有客户端，再重新连接。

mcp.list.clients.en: List online devices. A positive wait_ms returns early when any device is online. An empty clients array means no device was online when the call returned. An error means the check failed.
mcp.list.clients.zh-CN: 列出在线设备。wait_ms 为正值时，任一设备在线即提前返回。clients 为空表示返回时无设备在线。报错表示本次检查失败。

mcp.wait.for.connection.en: Wait in milliseconds for one poll. 0 returns an immediate snapshot. Values through 300000 are accepted with a 30000 ms cap.
mcp.wait.for.connection.zh-CN: 单次轮询等待毫秒数。0 立即查询。兼容不超过 300000 的值，单次实际等待上限为 30000 毫秒。

mcp.connection.context.en: Keep connection tokens, invitations, and commands private. Use list_client to check device connectivity. The server does not send background connection notifications.
mcp.connection.context.zh-CN: 私密保管连接令牌、邀请和连接命令。通过 list_client 检查设备是否在线。服务端不会在后台向 Agent 推送连接通知。

mcp.client.id.en: Device ID from list_client. Required with multi-device tokens for execute_command, session_read, session_control, and p2p_transfer_start.
mcp.client.id.zh-CN: list_client 返回的设备 ID。使用多设备令牌调用 execute_command、session_read、session_control 或 p2p_transfer_start 时必填。

unknown.client.id.en: Unknown or offline client_id for this token.
unknown.client.id.zh-CN: 此 Token 下没有该 client_id，或设备已离线。

client.id.required.en: client_id is required for multi-device tokens. Call list_client to select a device.
client.id.required.zh-CN: 多设备 Token 必须提供 client_id，请调用 list_client 选择设备。

multi.device.display.notice.en: Multi-device mode: multiple devices may stay connected simultaneously using the connection token or one-click commands. Short codes are not available in multi-device mode.
multi.device.display.notice.zh-CN: 多设备模式：可使用连接令牌或一键连接命令让多台设备同时在线。多设备模式不支持短码。

connection.retry.en: Connection lost or failed (online %s): %s. Retry #%d in %s.
connection.retry.zh-CN: 连接断开或失败（已连接 %s）：%s。第 %d 次重试将在 %s 后开始。

execution.cwd.invalid.en: cwd must not contain NUL bytes
execution.cwd.invalid.zh-CN: cwd 不能包含 NUL 字符

execution.env.invalid.en: environment names must be nonempty and contain neither = nor NUL; values must not contain NUL
execution.env.invalid.zh-CN: 环境变量名不能为空，且不能包含 = 或 NUL；变量值不能包含 NUL

mcp.execution.cwd.en: Initial working directory for the terminal created by setup. Change a reused shell with cd.
mcp.execution.cwd.zh-CN: setup 所创建终端的初始工作目录；复用后通过 cd 修改目录。

mcp.execution.env.en: Initial environment overrides for setup, merged with client environment. Change a reused shell through shell commands.
mcp.execution.env.zh-CN: setup 所创建终端的初始环境变量，与客户端环境合并；复用后通过 shell 命令修改。

mcp.execution.workflow.en: Run a command on a device. Use setup to create a terminal or session_id to reuse one. Omit both for an anonymous terminal, which closes on early completion or stays open if the wait expires. Commands can continue after the wait expires. Use session_read for more output and stop task-owned terminals when finished.
mcp.execution.workflow.zh-CN: 在设备上执行命令。用 setup 新建终端，或用 session_id 复用。两者都省略时创建匿名终端，命令先完成则关闭，等待先到期则保留。等待到期后命令可继续执行。用 session_read 继续读取，任务完成后停止本任务已用完的终端。

mcp.connection.wait.failed.en: Connection check failed; device connectivity is unknown: %v
mcp.connection.wait.failed.zh-CN: 连接检查失败，设备状态未知：%v

client.token.expired.en: Client token has expired; the invitation is no longer usable.
client.token.expired.zh-CN: 客户端 Token 已过期，邀请已不可用。

mcp.stop.wait.en: Only for action=stop: maximum wait for a terminal result in milliseconds, 0–20000; default 1000. 0 returns a snapshot immediately. Omit for all other actions.
mcp.stop.wait.zh-CN: 仅 action=stop 可用：请求取消后等待终态的最长毫秒数，范围 0–20000，默认 1000；0 表示立即返回状态快照。其他 action 不得填写。

mcp.stop.accepted.en: True if a cancellation request was sent or is pending. False for a session already ended before this call. This alone never confirms termination.
mcp.stop.accepted.zh-CN: 表示停止请求已发出或正在等待处理；调用前已结束时为 false。此字段本身不能确认进程已停止。

mcp.stop.done.en: True when a terminal result is available or the device connection closed; status and canceled identify the outcome.
mcp.stop.done.zh-CN: 收到终态结果或设备连接关闭时为 true；status 和 canceled 表示结束原因。

mcp.stop.status.en: running: stop is pending; closed: the client confirmed shell termination. A transport error does not confirm termination.
mcp.stop.status.zh-CN: running：停止尚待确认；closed：客户端确认 shell 已结束。传输错误不表示终止。

mcp.result.clients.en: Online devices owned by this token; an empty array means none are currently online.
mcp.result.clients.zh-CN: 此 token 的在线设备；空数组表示当前无在线设备。

mcp.result.client_id.en: Six-character device identifier. Required to select a device for multi-device tokens.
mcp.result.client_id.zh-CN: 六位设备标识；多设备 token 通过此字段选择目标设备。

mcp.result.client_info.en: Device-reported environment metadata. Empty fields mean unknown or not reported.
mcp.result.client_info.zh-CN: 设备上报的环境元数据，空字段表示未知或未上报。

mcp.result.client_version.en: Client application version reported during the connection handshake.
mcp.result.client_version.zh-CN: 客户端在连接握手中上报的应用版本。

mcp.result.arch.en: Client process architecture, such as amd64 or arm64.
mcp.result.arch.zh-CN: 客户端进程架构，例如 amd64 或 arm64。

mcp.result.default_cwd.en: Client working directory at connection time; inherited by a newly created session when cwd is omitted.
mcp.result.default_cwd.zh-CN: 连接时客户端的工作目录；新建会话未指定 cwd 时继承此目录。

mcp.result.hostname.en: Device-reported hostname for display only, not authentication.
mcp.result.hostname.zh-CN: 设备上报的主机名，仅用于展示，不用于认证。

mcp.result.shell.en: Device-reported persistent command interpreter path. Windows sessions use PowerShell; Linux/macOS use the reported shell. Empty means unknown.
mcp.result.shell.zh-CN: 设备上报的持续命令解释器路径；Windows 会话使用 PowerShell，Linux/macOS 使用上报的 shell。空值表示未知。

mcp.result.connected_at.en: UTC connection time in RFC 3339 format.
mcp.result.connected_at.zh-CN: RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 连接时间。

mcp.result.status.en: Connection wait status: waiting or connected.
mcp.result.status.zh-CN: 连接等待状态：waiting 或 connected。

mcp.client.status.en: Device connection display status: Connected, with the latest server-client heartbeat RTT when measured, e.g. Connected · 203ms.
mcp.client.status.zh-CN: 设备连接状态显示文本：Connected；有测量值时附带最近一次服务端与客户端之间的心跳往返延迟，例如 Connected · 203ms。

mcp.result.session_id.en: Client-local session identifier. Multi-device read/control also require client_id.
mcp.result.session_id.zh-CN: 客户端内唯一的会话标识，多设备读取和控制还必须提供 client_id。

mcp.result.output.en: Combined terminal output from the requested cursor; may contain echoed input.
mcp.result.output.zh-CN: 从指定游标开始的终端合并输出，可能包含回显输入。

mcp.result.next_cursor.en: Byte offset after the returned output. Pass it as cursor in the next session_read.
mcp.result.next_cursor.zh-CN: 本次输出结束处的字节偏移量。下次调用 session_read 时用作 cursor。

mcp.result.truncated.en: Present only as true when the requested cursor predates the oldest retained output. The latest 1 MiB is retained; pagination alone does not truncate.
mcp.result.truncated.zh-CN: 仅请求游标早于最早保留输出时返回 true；保留最近 1 MiB，单纯分页不会截断。

mcp.result.exit_code.en: execute/read/list: the latest completed command exit code, preserved when its shell later ends. stop: the confirmed shell termination code. 0 means success; -1 denotes execution failure. Transport errors never invent a code.
mcp.result.exit_code.zh-CN: execute/read/list：最新完成命令的退出码，shell 后续结束不会覆盖它。stop：已确认的 shell 终止码。0 表示成功，-1 表示执行失败。传输错误不会生成退出码。

mcp.result.error.en: Optional execution or connection error. A disconnect does not prove the remote process completed successfully.
mcp.result.error.zh-CN: 可选的执行或连接错误；断线不能证明远程进程成功完成。

mcp.result.control_token.en: Private scoped control credential in token:key format; never share with the target device.
mcp.result.control_token.zh-CN: 私密控制凭证，格式为 token:密钥；不得分享给目标设备。

mcp.result.multi_device.en: True permits multiple simultaneous devices and reuses the invitation until expiry. False allows one device and a single-use invitation.
mcp.result.multi_device.zh-CN: true 允许多台设备同时连接，邀请在过期前可复用；false 仅允许一台设备和单次使用邀请。

mcp.result.expires_at.en: Invitation expiry deadline as a UTC RFC 3339 timestamp.
mcp.result.expires_at.zh-CN: 邀请过期截止时间，使用 UTC RFC 3339 时间戳。

mcp.result.display_text.en: English connection instructions with Markdown code blocks, also returned as text content.
mcp.result.display_text.zh-CN: 英文连接说明，包含 Markdown 代码块，也作为工具的文本内容返回。

mcp.session.list.en: Find retained sessions on online devices. Use status=idle to find reusable terminals or status=live to inspect occupied terminal slots.
mcp.session.list.zh-CN: 查询在线设备保留的会话。用 status=idle 查找可复用终端，用 status=live 检查终端名额占用。

mcp.session.max.bytes.en: Maximum output bytes per read. The response preserves UTF-8 character boundaries.
mcp.session.max.bytes.zh-CN: 每次读取的输出字节上限。响应保证 UTF-8 字符完整。

mcp.result.session_controls.en: Supported acknowledged session operations: interrupt and/or eof. An empty list means these operations are unavailable; update older clients if needed.
mcp.result.session_controls.zh-CN: 客户端支持并能确认的会话操作：interrupt 和/或 eof。空列表表示不可用，旧客户端可能需要更新。

mcp.result.sessions.en: Retained sessions on the selected online devices.
mcp.result.sessions.zh-CN: 所选在线设备保留的会话。

mcp.result.command.en: Latest command preview, at most 160 Unicode characters; shortened previews end with ... (truncated).
mcp.result.command.zh-CN: 最新命令预览，最多 160 个 Unicode 字符；截断时以 ... (truncated) 结尾。

mcp.result.has_more.en: Whether more retained output is available after next_cursor.
mcp.result.has_more.zh-CN: next_cursor 之后是否还有保留输出。

session.read.invalid.limit.en: max_bytes must be an integer between 4 and 65536.
session.read.invalid.limit.zh-CN: max_bytes 必须为 4 到 65536 之间的整数。

session.read.invalid.arguments.en: cursor must be nonnegative and wait_ms must be between 0 and 20000.
session.read.invalid.arguments.zh-CN: cursor 不得为负数，wait_ms 必须在 0 到 20000 之间。

session.cursor.invalid.boundary.en: cursor must point to a UTF-8 character boundary; use the returned next_cursor.
session.cursor.invalid.boundary.zh-CN: cursor 必须位于 UTF-8 字符边界，请使用返回的 next_cursor。

session.control.unsupported.en: This client does not support the requested session operation. Check session_controls and update the client if needed.
session.control.unsupported.zh-CN: 该客户端不支持此会话操作，请检查 session_controls，必要时更新客户端。

session.control.no.foreground.en: The terminal has no foreground process group to interrupt.
session.control.no.foreground.zh-CN: 终端没有可中断的前台进程组。

session.eof.requires.canonical.en: EOF requires canonical terminal mode with VEOF enabled; raw mode is unsupported.
session.eof.requires.canonical.zh-CN: EOF 需要启用 VEOF 的规范终端模式，不支持原始模式。

session.input.queue.full.en: Session input queue is full; input was not queued.
session.input.queue.full.zh-CN: 会话输入队列已满，此次输入未入队。

mcp.session.control.en: Send input, interrupt, or EOF to an existing session, or stop its terminal. Check client_info.session_controls before interrupt or EOF. Avoid retrying input or signals when delivery is uncertain. After stop, use session_read to check for closed and drain output.
mcp.session.control.zh-CN: 向已有会话发送输入、中断或 EOF，或停止终端。中断或发送 EOF 前检查 client_info.session_controls。投递结果不明时避免重试输入或信号。停止后用 session_read 确认 closed 并读完输出。

mcp.session.control.action.en: Operation on this session: input sends stdin text (requires input); interrupt signals the foreground task; eof ends input according to platform semantics; stop cancels the entire session (optional wait_ms).
mcp.session.control.action.zh-CN: 会话操作：input 发送标准输入（必须带 input）；interrupt 中断前台任务；eof 按平台语义发送输入结束；stop 取消整个会话（可选 wait_ms）。

session.control.invalid.arguments.en: Use action=input with input, interrupt/eof without input or wait_ms, or stop with optional wait_ms (0–20000). A nonempty session_id is required.
session.control.invalid.arguments.zh-CN: action=input 必须带 input；interrupt/eof 不得带 input 或 wait_ms；stop 仅可附带 wait_ms（0–20000）。session_id 必须非空。

runtime.compatibility.error.en:
Incompatible runtime: server %s (API %s), runtime %s (API %s), runtime PID %s.
The running runtime will not be stopped or restarted automatically.
Use a server compatible with runtime API %s to stop this instance, for example:
  %s
Or stop runtime manually in the same user and host/container environment:
  %s
Stopping runtime disconnects clients and clears server credentials.
runtime.compatibility.error.zh-CN:
Runtime 不兼容：server %s（API %s），runtime %s（API %s），runtime PID %s。
不会自动停止或重启运行中的 runtime。
请使用兼容 runtime API %s 的 server 停止当前实例，例如：
  %s
或在相同用户及主机/容器环境中手动停止 runtime：
  %s
停止 runtime 会断开客户端连接，并清空服务端凭证。

runtime.compatibility.manual.unknown.en: Confirm the runtime PID first, then run: kill -TERM <PID>
runtime.compatibility.manual.unknown.zh-CN: 先确认 runtime PID，再执行：kill -TERM <PID>

mcp.p2p.transfer.start.en: Start the remote P2P helper and return after it registers. Run the private bootstrap script for the Agent's execution environment. Use the executable path it prints to check for connected before copying. Repeated calls reuse the device's active connection.
mcp.p2p.transfer.start.zh-CN: 启动远端 P2P 组件，等它注册后返回。按 Agent 的实际执行环境运行对应的私密脚本，用脚本输出的 executable 路径查询状态，等到 connected 后再复制文件。重复调用会复用设备的活动连接。

mcp.result.local_client_id.en: Local p2p-cli identifier used in CLIENT:PATH copy operands.
mcp.result.local_client_id.zh-CN: 用于 CLIENT:PATH 复制路径的本机 p2p-cli 标识。

mcp.result.remote_client_id.en: Remote p2p-cli identifier used in CLIENT:PATH copy operands.
mcp.result.remote_client_id.zh-CN: 用于 CLIENT:PATH 复制路径的远端 p2p-cli 标识。

mcp.result.state.en: Current P2P initialization state; waiting_for_agent means the remote registered, not that P2P connected.
mcp.result.state.zh-CN: P2P 初始化状态；waiting_for_agent 表示远端已注册，不表示直连已经成功。

mcp.result.shell_script.en: Private POSIX shell bootstrap for the Agent environment on macOS or Linux.
mcp.result.shell_script.zh-CN: 供 macOS 或 Linux Agent 执行环境使用的私有 shell 初始化脚本。

mcp.result.powershell_script.en: Private PowerShell bootstrap for the Agent environment on Windows.
mcp.result.powershell_script.zh-CN: 供 Windows Agent 执行环境使用的私有 PowerShell 初始化脚本。

mcp.result.p2p.en: Whether the client supports built-in p2p-cli initialization.
mcp.result.p2p.zh-CN: 客户端是否支持内置 p2p-cli 初始化。

session.busy.en: session_busy: session %s is running a command. Read or control it, or omit the terminal target for independent work.
session.busy.zh-CN: session_busy：会话 %s 正在执行命令，请读取或控制该会话，或不指定终端以独立执行。

session.command.changed.en: A newer command has started in this session. Use session_read without command_id to read the retained session output.
session.command.changed.zh-CN: 此会话已开始更新的命令；可不带 command_id 调用 session_read 读取保留输出。

mcp.execution.command.id.en: Optional command identifier returned by execution; pins reads to that command. New clients generate eight alphanumeric characters; older longer IDs remain accepted.
mcp.execution.command.id.zh-CN: 可选的执行返回命令标识，用于固定读取对应命令。新客户端生成 8 位字母数字，仍接受旧客户端返回的较长标识。

mcp.execution.wait.en: Maximum result wait in milliseconds. Completion returns early. 0 retains an anonymous terminal immediately after admission.
mcp.execution.wait.zh-CN: 等待执行结果的最长毫秒数。完成会提前返回。0 表示接纳命令后立即保留匿名终端。

mcp.result.command_id.en: Identifier of the latest command. New clients generate eight case-sensitive alphanumeric characters; older clients may return longer IDs.
mcp.result.command_id.zh-CN: 最新命令标识；新客户端生成区分大小写的 8 位字母数字，旧客户端可能返回较长标识。

mcp.execution.status.en: running: terminal busy or stop pending; idle: command ended and shell reusable; closed: client confirmed shell termination. Transport errors do not imply termination.
mcp.execution.status.zh-CN: running：终端忙碌或停止待确认；idle：命令结束且 shell 可复用；closed：客户端确认 shell 已结束。传输错误不表示终止。

mcp.execution.session.id.en: Reuse an existing session only. Unknown or closed IDs are rejected. To create a terminal, use setup instead.
mcp.execution.session.id.zh-CN: 仅复用已有会话；未知或已关闭 ID 报错。需要创建终端时使用 setup。

session.input.requires.command.en: No command is waiting for input. Submit new commands with execute_command.
session.input.requires.command.zh-CN: 当前没有命令可接收输入，请使用 execute_command 执行新命令。

session.setup.conflict.en: setup cannot be combined with top-level session_id.
session.setup.conflict.zh-CN: setup 不能与顶级 session_id 同时使用。

session.options.require.setup.en: cwd and env must be provided inside setup.
session.options.require.setup.zh-CN: cwd 和 env 必须放在 setup 中。

session.already.exists.en: Session %s already exists. Use top-level session_id to reuse it.
session.already.exists.zh-CN: 会话 %s 已存在，请通过顶级 session_id 复用。

mcp.execution.setup.en: Create a new terminal using optional cwd, env and session_id. Cannot be combined with top-level session_id. An existing setup.session_id is rejected. Omit its ID for a generated anonymous terminal with the usual wait-based lifetime.
mcp.execution.setup.zh-CN: 新建终端，可包含 cwd、env 和 session_id。不能与顶级 session_id 同时使用；setup.session_id 已存在时会报错。省略其中的 ID 时生成随机 ID，仍按匿名终端等待规则执行。

mcp.execution.setup.session.id.en: Optional ID for a new persistent terminal; fails if already present. Omit to generate a random ID and follow anonymous terminal lifetime.
mcp.execution.setup.session.id.zh-CN: 新建持久终端的可选 ID；已存在则报错。省略时生成随机 ID，并按匿名终端生命周期执行。

mcp.result.ok.en: The client acknowledged the operation request; does not prove the program consumed input or handled a signal.
mcp.result.ok.zh-CN: 客户端已确认操作请求，不代表程序已消费输入或处理中断。

mcp.close.client.en: Omit client_ids to close all online devices and revoke the token and its invitations, even when no devices are online. Pass client_ids from list_client to close only those devices. Closing a device ends its sessions and active transfers.
mcp.close.client.zh-CN: 省略 client_ids 会关闭该令牌下的全部在线设备并撤销令牌和邀请，即使当前没有设备在线也会撤销。传入 list_client 返回的设备 ID 则只关闭指定设备。设备关闭时会结束其会话和进行中的传输。

mcp.client.ids.en: Nonempty list of unique IDs from list_client for devices under this token.
mcp.client.ids.zh-CN: 该令牌下由 list_client 返回的设备 ID 列表，须非空且无重复。

mcp.result.client_ids.en: IDs of devices closed by this call.

client.api.required.en: The peer does not support the required client API version. Update both client and server.
client.api.required.zh-CN: 对端不支持所需的 client API 版本，请更新客户端和服务端。

mcp.result.terminal_api.en: Whether this device supports the terminal client API.
mcp.result.terminal_api.zh-CN: 此设备是否支持终端 client API。

installer.invalid.temp.directory.en: The temporary directory must have an absolute path.
installer.invalid.temp.directory.zh-CN: 系统临时目录必须使用绝对路径。

installer.consent.menu.zh-CN: 选择授权方式（↑/↓/←/→，回车确认）：

connection.idle.disconnected.zh-CN: 连接已因 5 分钟无操作自动断开。

mcp.session.list.status.en: Filter sessions by status. all is the default. live includes running and idle.
mcp.session.list.status.zh-CN: 按状态筛选会话。默认 all，live 包含 running 和 idle。
